name: Horizon Absolute
description: Vantablack Media's defining tentpole of the early 2190s — a 4-hour neural-feed epic in which you inhabit Sable Okonkwo-Reyes, a Tier 4 corporate liaison who discovers her corponation has been terraforming sections of the Great Lakes floor for illegal mineral extraction. Designed as a prestige action-drama, the film deploys full sensory immersion: cold lake water, the pressure of depth, the taste of adrenaline. Critics noted that despite its anti-corporate surface narrative, the ending reinforces corponation legitimacy — the protagonist reforms the system from within rather than dismantling it.
cultural_impact: Horizon Absolute normalized the 'loyal dissident' archetype in M88 storytelling — protagonists who expose wrongdoing but ultimately preserve the system — becoming a template Vantablack would return to repeatedly.
story_hooks: A player character discovers the lake-floor locations depicted in the film are real and actively operational.
A Vantablack executive offers the party a consultation fee to help bury a documentary that contradicts the film's sanitized ending.
Someone has been using pirated neural-feed copies of Horizon Absolute to smuggle encoded data in the sensory texture layers.
